espn-603993.headline: Ten Irishmen out, and Argentina are short too
beats: Garry Ringrose's hamstring makes him the tenth Ireland player ruled out, joining Caelan Doris, Jack Conan, Jack Crowley and six others. Sam Prendergast is a doubt with a wrist, Tadhg Furlong faces a disciplinary panel, and Andy Farrell has called up nobody.

Argentina have lost Santiago Carreras, 70 caps, to a leg injury and Thomas Gallo to a wrist, with Santiago Chocobares in doubt after a head knock. Their one win this year came against Wales in July. They have not won since: three defeats, one of them 17–10 to South Africa, and a 28–28 draw with Australia.
Ireland's last Test was a 40–21 defeat in New Zealand. They have been third in the world since July, and losing to a side that has won once all year would drop them below France.
South Africa come to Dublin on 21 November. Farrell would like a few of the ten back by then.

espn-603994.headline: Kolbe's out, which is Italy's best news since March
beats: Cheslin Kolbe will miss the rest of the Nations Championship with a broken jaw. André Esterhuizen limped off after barely a minute in Cardiff, and Handré Pollard is in doubt. South Africa still arrive unbeaten and top of the table, ahead of New Zealand only on points difference.
Italy's last win was against England at home on 7 March. In July they conceded 47 to New Zealand and 57 to Australia in successive weeks.

Sir Graham Henry admires Erasmus as a coach prepared to lose matches to improve the side. Here that has a price: anything short of a South African win hands first place in the world rankings to New Zealand.
The last meeting, in Italy in November 2025, went 32–14 to South Africa. That was before the defeat in Perth, and before anyone had to ask who plays on the wing.

espn-603995.headline: 33 meetings, two draws and still no Scotland win
beats: Draws in 1964 and 1983 are as good as it has got since these sides first met 111 years ago. Gregor Townsend lost 62-31 and 69-20 to them as a player. "As a player, I don't think we ever felt we could win the game," he says. "I've not felt that as a coach."

Their last meeting, at Murrayfield on 8 November 2025, made his case and undid it. Scotland trailed 17-0, drew level at 17-17 and lost 25-17. Townsend's view is that they lacked composure, not belief.

New Zealand lost three in a row to South Africa, then put 50 and 43 on Australia in October. Scotland last played in July, beating Fiji 33-17. A win would take them above England to fifth in the world.
As coach, Townsend has lost to New Zealand three times, by five, eight and eight points. That is a long way from 69-20, and still not a win.

sources.title: Townsend never felt he could beat All Blacks as a player, but as a coach...

espn-603996.headline: One point last November, one point in the table now
beats: Wales won the last meeting in Cardiff, 24–23, on 15 November 2025. Four months earlier, Japan had beaten them 24–19 in Kitakyushu, stretching Wales' losing streak to 18 Tests. Both now have one win from three, and Wales lead Japan by a point in the Nations Championship.

Wales have not played since July, when South Africa beat them 43–0. Japan won the Pacific Nations Cup by beating Fiji in September, then lost to Fiji 34–28 on 24 October and dropped three places in the rankings.

Wales lose Rio Dyer to a hamstring injury. His replacement is Macs Page, 21 and uncapped, with five tries in five games and a head knock from Cape Town still to clear. Lose here, and Wales would slip below Italy and Japan, 12th at best.
The loser's next game is New Zealand at home or England away.

espn-603997.headline: Eleven France absentees, and South Africa in six days
beats: Matthieu Jalibert, Thomas Ramos and Thibaud Flament were already out. Then Antoine Hastoy hurt his ankle in the Top 14, and the fly-half called in is Castres' Louis Le Brun, uncapped.

Fiji arrive bottom of the table with no points, having shipped 73 to England in July. They have since beaten Japan 34–28 in Tokyo, and new coach Jake White reckons they can make an impact at next year's World Cup.
Lose in Lyon and France fall out of the world's top four, below the England side that put those 73 past Fiji.

France won the last meeting 34–21 at home in November 2025. Six days after this one, South Africa come to the Stade de France, where last year they beat France 32–17 with 14 men for the entire second half.

espn-603998.headline: Lose to Australia and England take their place in 7th
beats: England have been 5th in every ranking since July. Australia are 7th, and a win by any margin swaps them: Australia up to 5th, England down to 7th, with Scotland slipping past England as well.

England won the last meeting 25–7 at home in November 2025. They have not played since July, when they put 73 on Fiji and 31 on Argentina. Australia beat South Africa 42–38 in September, then lost to New Zealand twice in October.

Fin Smith, who started at 10 in all three July Tests, strained a calf for Northampton against Leicester and has a Wednesday deadline from Steve Borthwick. If he misses out, George Ford or Marcus Smith takes the shirt.
Whoever wears 10 faces a defence that conceded 50 and 43 in a fortnight. As returns from a calf strain go, there are harder ones.
